decks.notes: This deck focuses on flooding the board with cheap, aggressive creatures in order to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The key strategy is to maximize the synergy between cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant to boost the team's power and disrupt the opponent's plans. With cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Brutal Cathar providing additional aggression, and support cards like Brave the Elements to protect our creatures, this deck aims to maintain a constant pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on using a variety of versatile control cards to disrupt the opponent's strategy while also utilizing the powerful card advantage and selection provided by Niv-Mizzet Reborn. The deck includes a mix of removal spells, ramp, and versatile threats to maintain board presence and answer threats efficiently. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion to provide additional value and a larger late-game advantage. The deck aims to control the game through disruption and card advantage until it can close out the game with powerful threats and overwhelming card advantage from Niv-Mizzet Reborn.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice synergies and efficient removal spells to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. By sacrificing creatures with cards like Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute, the deck generates value and triggers abilities like Mayhem Devil's ping effect. The inclusion of the Companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, provides additional mana acceleration and a powerful late-game threat. Overall, this aggressive Jund deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of creature removal, token generation, and recursive threats.

The primary focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and pump spells. The deck aims to deal damage early and often, utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Heartfire Hero, and Emberheart Challenger to apply pressure. The inclusion of Claim / Fame allows for graveyard recursion and the potential to bring back key creatures. With a mix of burn spells like Infuriate and Fatal Push, this deck looks to finish the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. Additionally, the deck includes Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for added value and consistency.

The deck focuses on using ramp and control elements to set up powerful late-game plays with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Niv-Mizzet Reborn. The deck also includes a variety of removal spells and disruptive cards to control the early game and protect its key threats. The mana base is diverse to support the four-color deck and ensure consistent access to all colors of mana. Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional ramp and a powerful companion option for the deck.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Callous Sell-Sword, Emberheart Challenger, and Monastery Swiftspear to quickly attack the opponent's life total. It also includes cards like Infuriate, Monstrous Rage, and Titan's Strength to pump up creatures for extra damage. The deck aims to end the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with a relentless stream of creatures combined with burn spells like Reckless Rage and Fatal Push. The companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional value and synergy with the deck's mana base.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive play. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Callous Sell-Sword, as well as powerful pump spells like Infuriate and Monstrous Rage, the deck aims to deal quick and efficient damage to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Turn Inside Out and Slickshot Show-Off provides additional versatility and removal options. The deck also benefits from the ramp ability of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, allowing for extra mana acceleration. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless assault.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. The deck includes strong creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Unstoppable Slasher, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to control the board. Duress and Thoughtseize provide disruption against opponents' strategies, while cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse offer additional value. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game, using a mix of creatures, removal, and disruption to secure victory.

This deck focuses on using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control tool, supported by a variety of multicolor spells and mana fixing to ensure optimized casting. The inclusion of Bring to Light allows for flexibility in fetching essential cards, while the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value through blinking permanents. With a mixture of removal spells, ramp, and threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and control the game until it can establish a dominant position and secure victory.

The deck focuses on creating early pressure with aggressive creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Moon-Circuit Hacker, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes cards like Floodpits Drowner and Faerie Miscreant to maintain board presence and card advantage. With a mix of efficient creatures and disruption spells, the Dimir Aggro deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure victory before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures, taking advantage of the synergy between white and green mana. By using cards like Collected Company and Skyclave Apparition, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong board presence. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben adds an additional layer of disruption, making it difficult for the opponent to cast their spells efficiently. The deck's mana base allows for consistency in casting its spells and maximizing its aggressive potential.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Enigmatic Incarnation to sacrifice creatures and search for higher converted mana cost creatures, creating a strong board presence and controlling the game. The deck includes a variety of creatures with different abilities to provide utility and answers to the opponent's threats. Additionally, the inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in the deck's strategy. With strong control elements and powerful creatures, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to build up a powerful creature by enchanting it with various auras like All That Glitters, Gryff's Boon, and Ethereal Armor. These auras not only boost the creature's power and toughness but also provide additional abilities. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a large, hexproof creature that is difficult to deal with. The inclusion of cards like Mox Amber and Jegantha, the Wellspring provide additional mana sources and flexibility in casting spells. Overall, this deck focuses on aggressive gameplay and boosting a single creature to dominate the battlefield.

This Pioneer Control deck focuses on using Niv-Mizzet Reborn to gain card advantage and control the game. It utilizes a toolbox of multicolored cards to provide answers to a variety of threats, with cards like Leyline Binding and Vanishing Verse to deal with opposing creatures and planeswalkers. The deck also includes powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Valki, God of Lies to apply pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Bring to Light allows for flexible casting of spells, while the Companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, provides additional value and card advantage.

This Arclight Phoenix aggro deck focuses on using cheap card draw and removal to quickly fill the graveyard with spells and bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard to deal damage and pressure the opponent. The deck includes abilities to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage, all while setting up explosive turns with multiple spells cast in a single turn. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive gameplay style, using the Phoenix as a powerful recurring threat.

This aggressive deck focuses on utilizing artifact creatures and equipment to quickly overwhelm opponents. By playing cheap artifacts and using cards like Metallic Rebuke to control the board, the deck aims to deal consistent damage and put pressure on the opponent early in the game. With cards like Metalwork Colossus as a powerful finisher and Ingenious Smith to help dig for key pieces, the deck combines artifact synergies with aggressive strategies to create a fast-paced and threatening playstyle. Additionally, cards like Portable Hole and Leyline Axe provide utility and additional ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan.
